title: Computer Scientist Explains One Concept in 5 Levels of Difficulty | WIRED
summary: WIRED has UCLA professor Amit Sahai explain zero-knowledge proofs to a child, a teen, a college student, a grad student and an expert. Each round goes deeper into the cryptography and why it matters.
why: It is the go-to accessible explanation of zero-knowledge proofs, linked whenever a thread needs an intuitive introduction.

quote.text: This is the best explanation I have seen
